footnote_text: On January 15, 2026, MAD Energy Limited Partnership (the "Partnership") pledged 6,655,702 shares of common stock of the Issuer to a third-party lender (the "Lender") as collateral for a loan to the Partnership. On September 8, 2026, the Lender declared an event of default under the loan and, in exercise of its remedies as a secured party, sold the pledged shares. The proceeds were applied to the loan, which was satisfied in full, and the remaining proceeds were remitted to the Partnership. The sale was effected by the Lender. Mr. Wentz does not participate in decisions of the Partnership or the General Partner with respect to securities of the Issuer, and he did not participate in the sale of the Issuer's common stock. || The price reported represents the volume-weighted average of the closing prices of the Issuer's common stock on September 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, and 11, 2026, as determined by the Lender pursuant to the terms of the loan. The aggregate price for the 6,655,702 shares was $34,510,882.13. || Reflects shares of common stock of the Issuer directly held by MAD Energy Limited Partnership (the "Partnership"). MAD Energy GP, LLC (the "General Partner") is the general partner of the Partnership. Mr. Wentz holds an indirect interest in the General Partner and is one of the managers of the General Partner. As a result, Mr. Wentz may be deemed to share beneficial ownership of the common stock of the Issuer held by the Partnership. Mr. Wentz disclaims beneficial ownership of such securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein, and this report shall not be deemed an admission that he is the beneficial owner of such securities for purposes of Section 16 or for any other purpose.
